= ndv(date_part('YEAR', orders.o_orderdate), nation.n_name | lineitem × nation × orders × part × partsupp × supplier where contains("part".p_name, 'green') and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_partkey = "part".p_partkey and lineitem.l_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey)
= ndv(lineitem.l_linestatus, lineitem.l_returnflag | lineitem where lineitem.l_shipdate <= CAST('1998-09-02' AS DATE))
= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey | lineitem)
= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_quantity > 49.00)

= ndv(lineitem.l_orderkey, orders.o_orderdate, orders.o_shippriority | customer × lineitem × orders where customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_shipdate > CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE))

= ndv(lineitem.l_shipmode | lineitem × orders where lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_receiptdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_receiptdate > lineitem.l_commitdate and lineitem.l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_shipdate < lineitem.l_commitdate and (lineitem.l_shipmode = 'MAIL' OR lineitem.l_shipmode = 'SHIP'))
= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem)
= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_quantity < 10.00)
= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_shipdate < CAST('1996-04-01' AS DATE) and lineitem.l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE))
= ndv(lineitem.l_suppkey | lineitem where lineitem.l_suppkey < 50)

= ndv(nation.n_name | customer × lineitem × nation × orders × region × supplier where customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey and customer.c_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_regionkey = "region".r_regionkey and orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) and "region".r_name = 'ASIA')
= ndv(orders.o_custkey | orders)
= ndv(orders.o_custkey | orders where orders.o_orderstatus = 'O')
= ndv(orders.o_custkey % 10 | orders)
= ndv(orders.o_orderpriority | customer × orders where customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey and customer.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING')

= ndv(orders.o_orderpriority | orders where orders.o_orderdate < CAST('1993-10-01' AS DATE) and orders.o_orderdate >= CAST('1993-07-01' AS DATE) and exists[lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey](lineitem where lineitem.l_receiptdate > lineitem.l_commitdate))

= ndv("part".p_brand, "part".p_size, "part".p_type | part × partsupp where NOT starts_with("part".p_type, 'MEDIUM POLISHED') and "part".p_brand <> 'Brand#45' and "part".p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey and ("part".p_size = 14 OR "part".p_size = 19 OR "part".p_size = 23 OR "part".p_size = 3 OR "part".p_size = 36 OR "part".p_size = 45 OR "part".p_size = 49 OR "part".p_size = 9) and not in[partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey](supplier where supplier.s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'))
= ndv(partsupp.ps_partkey | nation × partsupp × supplier where nation.n_name = 'GERMANY' and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey)
= ndv(partsupp.ps_partkey, partsupp.ps_suppkey | partsupp where partsupp.ps_availqty < 500)

= ndv(substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) | customer@1 × aggregate(customer@2 where "customer@2".c_acctbal > 0.00 and (substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '13' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '17' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '18' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '23' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '29' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '30' OR substr("customer@2".c_phone, 1, 2) = '31')) where CAST("customer@1".c_acctbal AS DECIMAL(19,6)) > "value"."avg(customer.c_acctbal) of aggregate(customer where customer.c_acctbal > 0.00 and (substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '13' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '17' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '18' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '23' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '29' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '30' OR substr(customer.c_phone, 1, 2) = '31'))" and (substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '13' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '17' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '18' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '23' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '29' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '30' OR substr("customer@1".c_phone, 1, 2) = '31') and not exists["customer@1".c_custkey = orders.o_custkey](orders))

= ndv(supplier.s_name | lineitem@1 × nation × orders × supplier where "lineitem@1".l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey and "lineitem@1".l_receiptdate > "lineitem@1".l_commitdate and "lineitem@1".l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey and nation.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA' and nation.n_nationkey = supplier.s_nationkey and orders.o_orderstatus = 'F' and exists["lineitem@1".l_orderkey = "lineitem@2".l_orderkey and "lineitem@1".l_suppkey <> "lineitem@2".l_suppkey](lineitem@2) and not exists["lineitem@1".l_orderkey = "lineitem@3".l_orderkey and "lineitem@1".l_suppkey <> "lineitem@3".l_suppkey](lineitem@3 where "lineitem@3".l_receiptdate > "lineitem@3".l_commitdate))

= ndv("value"."count(orders.o_orderkey) of group[customer.c_custkey](Left join[customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey](customer, orders where orders.o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'))" | group[customer.c_custkey](Left join[customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey](customer, orders where orders.o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%')))
= unique(partsupp.ps_partkey, partsupp.ps_suppkey | partsupp where partsupp.ps_availqty < 500)
? |customer where customer.c_acctbal > 9900.00|
? |orders where orders.o_orderstatus = 'P'|
? |orders where orders.o_totalprice > 400000.00|
? |part where starts_with("part".p_name, 'forest')|
? s(customer.c_acctbal > 9900.00 | customer)
? s(orders.o_orderstatus = 'P' | orders)
? s(orders.o_totalprice > 400000.00 | orders)
? s(starts_with("part".p_name, 'forest') | part)
